posts.author: Ramunas (GEOLA)
posts.post_subject: GEOLA News_photopolymer Bayfol HX200 already available in small quantities
posts.content_md:
Hello Colleagues!

I'm glad to announce that along other light sensitive materials supplied by Geola Digital from now on we also offer unique, self-processing Color Photopolymer Bayfol® HX200 film in two shapes, rolls and sheets.

More information on available sizes and specs can be found on our website: [http://geola.com/product/photopolymer/](http://geola.com/product/photopolymer/)

The Bayfol® HX200 material availability is subject to simple questionnaire.

Thanks and all the best!
